core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Feroz corresponds to the Persian form فيروز (Persian پیروزه (pīrūza) / فیروزه). Its core sense is turquoise. Feroz/Firoz is the Persian name فیروز (Fīrūz), from Middle Persian pērōz 'victorious', which also gave the name of the gemstone turquoise (فیروزه fīrūza). The source record labelled it 'Arabic'; the word is Persian in origin, later borrowed into Arabic as فيروز. The 'strong, brave' gloss in the source is not the lexical meaning. Note also that the source record for the related slug firoz carried the Arabic form أحمد, which is wrong (see firoz).
